newsitem.title: INDIA: India gold, silver down on losses in world markets.
newsitem.headline: India gold, silver down on losses in world markets.

text.p: Indian gold and silver ended Friday weaker after opening on subdued note on the back of overnight losses in global markets, traders said.
Prices of gold biscuits (116.50 grammes each) ended Friday 300 rupees lower at 56,100 rupees per piece.
"Demand was low while traders were unloading stocks on fears that the customs department may resume sale of confiscated stocks," one broker said.
"The department has already commenced sales in southern India and may start in Bombay shortly," he added.
Overall sentiments were subdued at close, traders said.
